functions.name: Auto entry title handler
functions.description: Single dispatcher for the auto-entry-title app. Handles Entry.publish events for Region renames and Release.* / ScheduledAction.* events for Launch Release schedule changes.

functions.name: Auto entry title concept recompute
functions.description: Recomputes auto-titles for every entry tagged with the given taxonomy concepts. Invoked manually after editing a concept's notation — no App Event topic fires on taxonomy changes.

actions.name: Recompute titles for taxonomy concepts
actions.description: Recomputes the auto-generated title of every entry tagged with the listed concepts. Run this after changing a concept's notation.

parameters.name: Concept IDs
parameters.description: Comma-separated taxonomy concept ids, e.g. "mens,doubleRl". App Action parameters have no array type, hence the comma-separated Symbol.
